# UI

- **Check accessible names after an edit, not only on load.** Look the field up by its
  name in a test after typing into it.
- **Configure a third-party widget through its config, not by patching its DOM after
  creation.** Its render loop rewrites attributes such as `aria-label`. For its CSS, match
  or exceed its own selectors. *(2026-10-11-third-party-editor-overrides)*
- **Before restyling a component, find the code that reads its computed style.**
  Exporters, measurers and probes read styles no screenshot shows. Run one on the change,
  and make it handle the empty case.
  *(2026-10-18-restyling-breaks-programs-that-read-styles)*
- **One shape, one border, one focus ring for every text field, whatever draws it.**
  Corners vary by tier (controls tighter than cards), never by library.
  *(2026-10-11-third-party-editor-overrides)*
- **Theme with tokens, never hardcoded black or white.** Check both themes and a phone
  width before calling a screen done.
- **Count WebGL contexts on a page of canvases; past about sixteen, the oldest are lost.**
  Lost contexts look like shader bugs with no log. Pool a few and keep each card's frame as
  an image. *(2026-10-11-browsers-cap-webgl-contexts-per-page)*
- **A custom property changed per frame restyles every element that reads it.** Register
  it with inherits: false, set it only where read, and draw many small things on one canvas.
  *(2026-10-16-per-frame-custom-properties-restyle-every-reader)*
